name: Álvaro IV of Kongo
contribution: A ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo from 1631 to 1636.
legacy: The king was the last of the House of Kwilu monarchs which had ruled the kingdom with only one intermission since 1567

checks.lead: Álvaro IV of Kongo, also known as Álvaro IV Nzinga a Nkuwu, was a ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo from 1631 to 1636.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
